experiment.name: huginn_half_depth
experiment.paper_setting: Table A8: Huginn-0125, logit guidance, 32 to 16 loops, reference h5, fixed omega=0.5

scope: Huginn-0125 on the complete SciQ test split, 0-shot.

protocol.attention_count: Dense QK and AV matrix products, no causal triangle discount.
protocol.counted: Attention and MLP matrices, recurrent injection, coda, and vocabulary head.
protocol.excluded: Embedding lookup, normalization, RoPE, activations, biases, residual additions, and guidance vector arithmetic.
protocol.paper_source: sources/looped_qwen/loopcd.html, Appendix D.1 and Tables A7-A9

flops_512_token_prefill.accounting_difference: The printed Huginn TFLOPs match the Transformer blocks and head with dense attention. Including the released core_block_forward's 2d-to-d injection matrix adds one projection per recurrent step. Both ledgers are shown; the injection-inclusive ledger counts all forward matrix products.

methodology.selection: Sort all task candidates by input length, question index, and choice index. Use contiguous fixed-size slices centered on i/(batches+1) length quantiles.
methodology.scope: Standalone teacher-forced answer-token log probabilities on sampled batches.
methodology.timed_operations: Input validation, initial-state clone, embedding, prelude, recurrence, policy-specific coda/head, fixed guidance if used, log_softmax and target gather. CUDA is synchronized before and after each perf_counter measurement.
methodology.excluded_from_policy_timing: Checkpoint loading, tokenizer/data preparation, tensor construction/transfer, initial random-state generation and its transfer, warmup, and result serialization.
methodology.initial_state_handling: One stable CPU truncated-normal state per input batch is transferred before timing and reused unchanged for every policy and repetition. Separate timings record the actual adapter state generation plus GPU transfer.
methodology.initial_state_storage: Precomputed initial states for all sampled batches remain on GPU.
methodology.output_projection: All vocabulary logits at answer-predicting positions only.
methodology.order: Repetition r rotates batch order by r; within batch b it rotates policy order by r+b. Each measurement uses an independent forward pass.
methodology.aggregate: Sum one measured latency from each sampled batch within a repetition; report median, quartiles and MAD across repetitions. Speedup is the ratio of baseline-R32 median aggregate latency to policy median aggregate latency.
methodology.interpretation: Sampled inference latency; full-task evaluation throughput is not measured.

adapter_metadata.noise_key: SHA256(seed, question ID), independent of answer text
adapter_metadata.noise_generation: CPU float32 truncated normal, fixed 64-token blocks; then cast to model dtype
adapter_metadata.noise_coupling: same question shares identical positional initial states across options and depths
adapter_metadata.paper_rng_difference: Paper seed and sample ordering are not specified; this fixes an explicit reproducible RNG protocol.
adapter_metadata.padding: right padding only; native causal attention makes suffix padding invisible to scored tokens
adapter_metadata.bos_policy: Prepend exactly one BOS to context; no special tokens in continuation.

checkpoint.large_weight_audit_scope: Current file sizes checked; SHA256 values are the pinned download verification records. This analysis does not rehash large weight files or prove which bytes were loaded by a past process.
